diagram.title: One Work, from sources to delivery

stages.title: Sources and goals
stages.explanation: Synthetic example: keep the goal, sources and valid decisions on one Work. Preserve large materials in files and read only the sections needed now.

stages.title: Capability roles
stages.explanation: Confirm system modules first, then refine each module. Independent modules can proceed in parallel; local problems return only the affected part for revision.

stages.title: Verify and adopt
stages.explanation: Check delivered files and receipts. Record output, verification and adoption separately; the animation explains the rules and does not prove execution.
